name: kitchen
prompt: A kitchen archivist labels a row of sealed recipe cards with small whole numbers. Each card has a title, a list of ingredients, a preparation note, and a number written in the lower right corner. The archivist checks the number before placing a card in a box because the printed title may be reused on several cards. On this afternoon's table there are three blank cards and four completed cards. The completed cards carry the numbers two, four, six, and seven. The blank cards will not enter the box today. A trainee is asked to copy only the number from the final completed card, without sorting the cards again and without adding the blank cards to the count. The trainee reads the preparation notes first but does not alter any number.
